checks: Preserved systolic/diastolic definitions as two values within one cardiac cycle, not names of hypertension/hypotension diseases; paired recording and no new diagnostic threshold.

Preserved diurnal variation, measurement time/posture/prior activity and differing conditions for two readings; no disregarding an abnormal post-activity value or inferring onset/cure from one reading; individual plan and institution procedure retained.
Preserved excitement, tension, sleep shortage, sudden exertion/temperature change, straining and holding excretion; no request to suppress excretion for staff scheduling.

Preserved absent symptoms versus possible hypertension and actual measurement plus healthcare-professional evaluation; lifestyle/hereditary versus other-disease causes and no blanket claim that every cardiac disease causes hypertension.
Preserved infarction versus hemorrhage/subarachnoid hemorrhage, coronary flow/angina/infarction and vessel-wall change; multi-organ evaluation and no diagnostic inference from one absent symptom.
Preserved treatment/support-plan limits and no staff-directed medication stopping/dose changes, with concrete values/usual differences/person’s own words.

Preserved person-based left/right, body-region/surface distinctions, wrist versus arm/fingertips, sole versus dorsum, waist versus whole back and buttock synonyms. Less-affected side retains established term with explicit no-guarantee qualification.
Preserved report location/laterality/time/person’s words, unknown intensity/cause not inferred and no delay in reporting sudden changes until every question is answered.

Preserved brain/spinal-cord central versus peripheral roles and two-way sensory/motor information with reflex involvement;12pairs/31pairs not12or31single nerves. Body-location labels are not automatically pair names.

Preserved cerebrum/cerebellum/diencephalon/brainstem distinctions; midbrain/pons/medulla are brainstem components, thalamus/hypothalamus are diencephalic. Parts work together and diagrams are not a self-diagnosis procedure.

Preserved autonomic organ-specific tendencies and situational qualifications; sympathetic/parasympathetic heart-rate directions do not determine an unmeasured personal pulse or pressure. Anxiety observation remains separate from measured blood-pressure change.

Preserved pupil/digestive/bronchial direction tendencies and no neurologic testing/medication selection instruction. Eccrine sweating retains sympathetic importance and no invented direct parasympathetic stop mechanism or universal symmetric two-arrow model.

Retained exact healthcare-professional recipients, professional consultation, respectful adult reference with no invented gender/age/kinship, all7lesson art limitations and all28specific reasons without compression.
